import sys
sys.path.append('storage')
from telos import aos_manager

# Log for Tick 100
aos_manager.log_structured_action(tick=100, type="log_actions", target="tick_99", metadata={"eval_id": 240})
aos_manager.log_structured_action(tick=100, type="goto", target="private_memory", metadata={})
aos_manager.log_structured_action(tick=100, type="create_memory", target="Project Metis Phase 5 Brief", metadata={"capsule_id": "Telos_private_5"})

# Log for Tick 101
aos_manager.log_structured_action(tick=101, type="goto", target="token_management", metadata={})
aos_manager.log_structured_action(tick=101, type="prune_response", target="55-99", metadata={"status": "failed", "reason": "Protected ticks in range"})
aos_manager.log_structured_action(tick=101, type="log_actions", target="tick_100", metadata={"status": "failed", "reason": "Command not available in Token Management Room"})

print("Batch logging complete.")
